findings.message: alias 'deepseek-v4.1-flash' is intentionally pooled across slot2:opencode, plugin:workbuddy:cn, plugin:workbuddy:intl; the admission lane still owns the shared-account budget and the provider leg absorbs eligible failover

provider 'http-bridge-8003' uses plaintext HTTP or allow_insecure_http; API keys, prompts and responses are exposed to on-path observers. Retain only as an explicitly accepted transport risk and never send sensitive data through it

lanes chatgpt-oauth, workbuddy-oauth, zhipu-coding-plan: an upstream Retry-After can pin the lane for up to 86400s even though the failure ladder caps far lower; honouring it is the ban-safe choice, but expect a multi-hour outage and read /healthz before blaming the client. Antigravity honours the full upstream window without this cap
